evidence_required: six items; the NCCL log signature.

marking.criterion: Platform P2P support with GPU and NIC under one PCIe switch
Peer-memory mechanism: nvidia_peermem (legacy nv_peer_mem) or a verified DMA-BUF path
IOMMU configured per vendor guidance (often iommu=pt)
No ACS redirect on the GPU/NIC switch ports
Runtime proof: NCCL channel lines ending /GDRDMA or ib_write_bw --use_cuda; the distance-check line alone is not sufficient

title: GPUDirect RDMA prerequisites
